# Town of Stamford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): John Paul Potvin was elected Moderator as a write-in candidate NAMED in the official tally (63 votes; he also won School Moderator with 53) -- a certified write-in outcome with the name printed in the tally itself (flagged on issue #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Lori A. Shepard was elected Town Clerk with 108 votes (three-year term to 2029)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lori A. Shepard as Stamford's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Lori A. Shepard was elected Town Treasurer with 108 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lori A. Shepard as Stamford's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Nancy Bushika (Chair), Michael Denault, John Dunn, Kurt Gamari, and Jedidiah Gramlin

Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Kurt Gamari was elected to the three-year seat with 99 votes and Jedidiah Gramlin to the two-year seat with 84 votes (Stamford elects its five members on mixed two- and three-year terms)

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Stamford Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes
Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Sally A. Bohl was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 89 votes
Town of Stamford, 2023 Town Report, 'Elected Town Officers' and 'Appointed Town Officers' lists and the 2024 annual meeting warning printed in the report: Bohl also held the office in 2023
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms

Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Kristin Malachuk was elected Lister as a write-in candidate NAMED in the official tally (21 votes, the three-year seat) -- a certified write-in outcome (flagged on issue #163). The one-year remainder contest drew no write-in votes and the third seat is published nowhere, so two seats stand unfilled
Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): Luke McKay was elected Cemetery Commissioner with 98 votes

Town of Stamford, 2023 Town Report, 'Elected Town Officers' and 'Appointed Town Officers' lists and the 2024 annual meeting warning printed in the report: the 2023 roster (David McKay, Sheila G. Lawrence, and one further seat) predates two election cycles and is stale, so the other two seats stand unfilled

Town of Stamford, 2023 Town Report, 'Elected Town Officers' and 'Appointed Town Officers' lists and the 2024 annual meeting warning printed in the report: the Stamford Free Library's trustees are elected (the 2023 report's elected list shows five trustees, although its term labels conflict between three- and five-year terms -- flagged on issue #163)

Town of Stamford, official marked results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, stamfordvt.net): the single 2026 library seat drew no write-in votes and the current trustees are published nowhere official, so the post is created without memberships (straggler)
